risk_note: RV2 by path. FU-R7-RIGHTS-ESTIMATE: a partial rights result before credit now lowers what users see. Wallet, order page and earnings board subtract the open deductions from ESTIMATED / WAITING (N_new = effective commission less open deductions, floor 0, the same figure R5 credits, D10-474, D10-483); the order commission columns stay unwritten. An order with no settlement record, a known N and a changed N moves commission_version in the same CAS and refresh writes that version at N_new; an order with a settlement column or record does not move, because the bill compares b_settle with the current base. Without open deductions every figure is unchanged. No contract, no migration, no ledger entry. Left by ruling: bill does not subtract open deductions yet and amount rows of settled orders stay pre-deduction (FU-BILL-OPEN-DEDUCTIONS, D10-578).
